shots.x: The Ocean of Milk from above: the mountain turning in white water, and two lines of figures running out to either horizon on one serpent.
shots.vo: They were made to pull the same rope, and not one of them could see what was holding the mountain up.

shots.x: Blistered hands close on the serpent's body, knuckles white, the skin of the palm split.
An Asura's face at the serpent's head, teeth set, smoke coughing past him.
From the waterline the mountain spins, and nothing that can be seen is holding it up.
